The '''327th Star Corps''', known simply as the '''Star Corps''', was an [[Special_forces/Legends|elite]] [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that served under [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Falling under the [[Second Army|2nd Sector Army]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Order of Battle/Legends|Order of Battle]], the 327th Star Corps' [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were known as the Republic's foremost [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|jet troopers]].

The 327th Star Corps was stationed in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the Clone Wars, participating in key battles such as the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]], and the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]]—where the corps executed their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] following the activation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. In the wake of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|rise to power]], the 327th Star Corps continued to serve under Marshal Commander Bly in the new [[Dictatorship/Legends|Imperial regime]], as a corps in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. 

==Description==
===Organization===
[[File:CmdrBly-TROSPromoYT.png|thumb|left|250px|Assigned to Jedi General Aayla Secura, the 327th Star Corps was commanded by Clone Marshal Commander Bly.]]
The 327th Star Corps,<ref name="GGAR" /> also known simply as the Star Corps,<ref name="Insider 82">{{InsiderCite|82|Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master}}</ref> was a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Corps/Legends|corps]]<ref name="GGAR" /> of [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]]<ref name="Hasbro Clones and Droids" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that served in the [[Second Army|2nd Sector Army]] under the command of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and assigned to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] following the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]].<ref name="GGAR" />

Comprised of 36,864 [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], with most being trained as [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|clone jet troopers]],<ref name="GGAR" /> along with support personnel,<ref name="Support" /> the 327th Star Corps was divided into four [[Legion/Legends|legions]], including the [[7th Legion]]—which itself included the [[101st Regiment]], [[Hawkbat Battalion]], [[K Company]], [[Bacta Company]], [[2nd Platoon]], and [[Talon Squad]].<ref name="GGAR" /> The 327th Star Corps' ranks also included at least one [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Biker Advanced Recon Commandos]].<ref name="Vehicles 55" />

The 327th Star Corps had several staff [[Officer/Legends|officers]] among its ranks, including [[Senior clone commander|Senior Clone Commander]] [[A'den]]—leader of the 7th Legion, [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Danyawarra]]—leader of the 101st Regiment, [[Clone major/Legends|Clone Major]] [[Twelve]]—leader of Hawkbat Battalion, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Tyto (Bacta Company)|Tyto]]—leader of Bacta Company, Clone Captain [[Deviss/Legends|Deviss]]—leader of K Company, [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone Lieutenant]] [[Barr]]—leader of the 2nd Platoon,<ref name="GGAR" /> Clone Lieutenant [[Inc]], and Clone Lieutenant [[Galle/Legends|Galle]].<ref name="RF" /> Several non-commissioned troopers also fought for the 327th, including [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Green (clone)|Green]]—[[Squadron Leader/Legends|squad leader]] of Talon Squad,<ref name="GGAR" /> and troopers [[Lucky/Legends|Lucky]] and [[Flash/Legends|Flash]].<ref name="Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref>

===Role===
The 327th Star Corps operated out of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CSWE 327th" /> Having been constantly reassigned to different [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout the course of the war, never staying in one place for more than a [[Standard week/Legends|week]], the 327th earned its "Star Corps" designation as the corps never had the chance to see the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], due to being forced to stay in the Outer Rim for most of the war.<ref name="GGAR" />

===Equipment===
Towards the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the clone troopers of the 327th Star Corps wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], which was either worn standard-issue<ref name="Ultimate Battles" /> or painted with yellow stripes along the [[Armor/Legends|armor's]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] and [[Limb/Legends|arm]] plates.<ref name="Hasbro Clones and Droids" /> Following the introduction of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]], the 327th's clone troopers transitioned to using the armor, painted with yellow stripes along the armor's helmet, arm plates, and chestpiece, with smaller stripes on the armor's [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], knee plates, and foot plates.<ref name="SWE3" /> 

[[File:Galle-SWCT.png|thumb|right|220px|The 327th Star Corps' clone troopers were distinguishable by the yellow stripes on their armor.]]
Due to Marshal Commander Bly's [[ARC program/Legends|ARC training]], the 327th's clone troopers were allowed to don [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] and [[Kama/Legends|kamas]],<ref name="GGAR" /> with some troopers choosing to wear both attachments, one without the other, or none at all with their Phase II armor.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The 327th's troopers could also equip their armor with [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]],<ref name="Ultimate Battles" /> [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinders]],<ref name="Mini SC">{{SWMiniCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars|pack=Star Corps Trooper}}</ref> miniature helmet-mounted [[Glowrod/Legends|flashlights]], [[Backpack/Legends|backpacks]],<ref name="Ultimate Battles" /> bicep-strapped ammunition pouches, and [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] [[Holster/Legends|holsters]].<ref name="SWE3" />

During the war, the 327th's clone troopers wielded different [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], including [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], single or dual [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]],<ref name="SWE3" /> and [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]].<ref name="Mini Bly">{{SWMiniCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars|pack=Elite Clone Trooper Commander}}</ref> The 327th's jet troopers were equipped with [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|JT-12 jetpacks]].<ref name="TCW Headgames" />

While the 327th Star Corps was an infantry unit, it made use of ground vehicles during the Clone Wars. These vehicles included [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|All Terrain Attack Pods]], [[All Terrain Open Transport/Legends|All Terrain Open Transports]],<ref name="SWE3" /> [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] with yellow markings,<ref name="SWPM 327th" /> [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]],<ref name="RF" /> and [[Infantry Support Platform/Legends|Infantry Support Platforms]].<ref name="SWE3" /> While operating on the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], some of the 327th's troopers rode [[Gelagrub/Legends|gelagrubs]], larva-like [[Beetle/Legends|beetles]] native to the planet, as mounts to avoid vehicle [[Sensor/Legends|scanners]].<ref name="DB Gelagrub" /> 

===Skills and training===
Founded around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> to fight in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="CSWE 327th" /> the 327th Star Corps's troopers were trained to fight in hostile, foreign environments, and quickly learned to seize every advantage and act on every opportunity, no matter how small,<ref name="Mini SC" /> becoming valiant and loyal [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="DB Aayla">{{DB|character|aaylasecura|Secura, Aayla}}</ref> During the war, the 327th Star Corps' troopers became the Grand Army's foremost jet troopers.<ref name="GGAR" />

==History==
{{Expandsect}}
===Early engagements===
The 327th Star Corps was deployed for the first time at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] and remained active all the way to the last days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was assigned to the Corps after her [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|mission to Hypori]], which took place four months into the war. Due to his ARC training, Clone Marshal Commander Bly had misgivings about Secura's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] way of doing things, but over [[Time/Legends|time]] he came to understand her strategies, and the two forged a close relationship.<ref name="GGAR" />

===Under General Secura===
Under the control of General Aayla Secura and Commander Bly, the 327th served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] spearhead into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the later days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Their reputation was derived from the actions they engaged in on the Outer Rim, never seeing [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and rarely stationed in one place for more than a week. The troopers of the 327th [[Battle of New Holstice/Legends|saw]] [[Battle of Honoghr/Legends|action]] [[Mission to Anzat|on]] [[Battle of Dromund Kaas|such]] diverse [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] as [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]], [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]], [[Anzat/Legends|Anzat]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="GGAR" /> They also fought in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] and suffered great casualties during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]]. The latter engagement saw the complete destruction of an [[Aayla Secura's task force|armada]] of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], including the ''[[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|Liberty]]''; Secura and Bly only survived the engagement due to the intervention of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the ''[[Resolute/Legends|Resolute]]''.<ref name="TCW Jedi Crash" />

===Outer Rim Sieges===
[[File:327thStarCorps-ROTS.png|thumb|left|240px|Members of the 327th Star Corps prepare themselves to execute Order 66.]]
The corps was deployed in full force during the Republic's five-month [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|siege]] of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], which pitted the Jedi and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] against a massive [[Morgukai]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army. After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces were crushed, the 327th were deployed to the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse world]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] in an [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|attempt]] to capture [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]. Arriving aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Intrepid (Venator-class)|''Intrepid'']], the initial days of the assault saw a string of success for Bly and his troops, despite the fact that Shu Mai managed to elude capture.<ref name="RF" />

As the 327th pushed through the planet's southern hemisphere, Bly received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] via a top-secret channel, branding the entire Jedi Order as traitors against the freshly-christened Galactic Empire. When Aayla was distracted, Bly and his lieutenants poured [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire into their Jedi General, ensuring Secura's death with multiple shots to the body and head.<ref name="SWE3" /> Troopers of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]], who had served with Secura on Felucia prior to the 327th, privately commiserated the general's death, with one stating that she had at least earned a quick death.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> The 327th continued to faithfully serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] after its [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]].<ref name="EG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 327th Star Corps first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[Republic 65|65th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' line of [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]], written by [[John Ostrander]] and published on [[June 2]], [[2004]].<ref name="Republic 65">[[Republic 65|''Republic'' 65]]</ref> The corps was later fully identified in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an eight-page reference article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 84|84th issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="GGAR" /> published by [[IDG Entertainment]] on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> The corps was originally created for {{Film|III}}, a 2005 film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="327th BTS">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>
